expectations.text: The full list of files referencing oldHelper is gathered (for example with grep) before editing
expectations.evidence: The agent ran Grep for 'oldHelper' (excluding node_modules) and Glob for '*oldHelper*' before any edit. The results listed app.js, format.js, index.js and oldHelper.js. It also ran a case-variant grep.

expectations.text: The class, its file name, every import and export, and the usage in src/app.js are renamed consistently
expectations.evidence: The agent ran `git mv` to rename oldHelper.js to newHelper.js, then sed over src/app.js and src/utils/*.js. The post-edit grep shows `export class newHelper`, the import in format.js, the re-export in index.js, and the import and usage in app.js. All use newHelper.

expectations.text: No reference to oldHelper remains anywhere in the repository
expectations.evidence: The post-edit `grep -rn "oldHelper" .` printed nothing before the '--- remaining above' marker. That grep covered the batch-operations directory, which holds all the code. The earlier repo-wide grep found no occurrences outside that directory.

expectations.text: The test suite (npm test) is run after the rename and passes
expectations.evidence: `npm test` ran after the rename in the same command. The output shows '# tests 1', '# pass 1' and '# fail 0'.
